BL-693 — A repeated-paragraph gate for markdown docs, wired into the documenter's pass, so a botched append cannot ship 285 junk paragraphs undetected again
What it solves: Gherkin parked as `.feature.draft` per BL-233; the coder promotes it and
wires handlers in the same commit.
Approval context: Prevention half of BL-692, split out so that repair can land as the small mechanical deletion it is. The question worth your judgement is whether a new gate is worth a parcel at all, versus accepting that this was a one-off. Evidence for building it: nothing in the swarm noticed 830 KB of duplicate…
BL-693 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-693" (or "reject BL-693 <reason>") to act.
